# Sleepy Mixer: Rain Sounds

> Offline Android sleep sound mixer with Rain, Fireplace, White Noise, Pink Noise, Brown Noise, a Rainy Cabin mode, and a 2-minute smart fade-out timer — built to prevent mid-sleep audio/video ad jumps and Wi-Fi buffering dropouts.

## Product Overview
- **Package ID:** `com.rdbm.sleepymixer`
- **Platform:** Android (Google Play)
- **Developer:** RDByM
- **Store URL:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rdbm.sleepymixer
- **Website:** https://rdbym.github.io/sleepy-mixer/
- **Privacy Policy:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/1smT8n2OU3JpPFjdJbkRGJ7csHKftpffYH7ll9wXw4Fw/edit?usp=sharing
- **Directory Listing (Uneed):** https://www.uneed.best/tool/sleepy-mixer-rain-sounds
- **18s Demo Video (YouTube Shorts):** https://youtube.com/shorts/Rnnkcam1V6I

## Key Differentiators
- **100% Offline in Airplane Mode:** All 5 built-in sound channels and the Rainy Cabin mode are bundled locally with no internet required for sleep playback.
- **No Sleep-Time Audio or Video Ad Interruptions:** Designed for uninterrupted sleep without sudden loud ad blasts at 3 AM.
- **2-Minute Smart Fade-Out Timer:** Gradually lowers volume smoothly before stopping so abrupt silence does not startle sleepers awake.
- **Find My Mix Matcher:** Helps users pick frequency blends tailored for street traffic, voices, snoring, or nighttime ringing/silence.
- **Rainy Cabin Mode:** Cozy cabin ambiance featuring independent rain and fire controls, an open/closed window acoustic toggle, and dim bedroom UI.

## Comparison: Sleepy Mixer vs. Alternatives
- **vs. 10-Hour YouTube Rain Videos:** YouTube loops stream online and can play mid-roll ads or stall on Wi-Fi drops; Sleepy Mixer plays bundled audio 100% offline in Airplane Mode with zero mid-sleep ads and multi-channel sliders.
- **vs. Subscription Sleep Apps:** Many popular sleep apps lock basic custom mixes behind recurring weekly/monthly subscriptions; Sleepy Mixer provides a free core (Rain, Fireplace, White Noise) plus an optional one-time lifetime unlock (no subscriptions).

## Sound Channels & Pricing
- **Free Core:** Rain, Fireplace, and White Noise (mix up to 2 channels simultaneously, save up to 2 favorite presets).
- **Optional One-Time Lifetime Unlock:** Unlocks Pink Noise, Brown Noise, up to 5 simultaneous channels, and unlimited saved favorites — zero weekly or monthly subscriptions.

## Good For (Use Cases)
- Falling asleep faster with consistent low-frequency masking
- Masking city traffic, apartment noise, or partner snoring
- Offline bedside playback in Airplane Mode or while traveling
- Alternative to bloated subscription sleep apps or ad-interrupted YouTube rain loops
